defaultPrompt: Run an SEO report on my website with mobile and desktop PageSpeed tests.
Review my existing SEO report and prioritize improvements.
Help me get started with RankRadar SEO.
interface.longDescription: Turn a website URL into an evidence-backed SEO audit with transparent scores, mobile/desktop PageSpeed results where tools permit, and prioritized Markdown/PDF reports. Includes setup guidance and a standard-library PageSpeed helper. Uses the host's available tools; it does not bundle a remote crawler or a local Command Code bridge.
